product_type: Rear combination lamp: an exterior lighting and signalling module that combines rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions with a retro-reflector behind one outer lens in a single housing.
mounting_location: Vehicle rear, outboard corner (body-mounted rear lamp cluster). The drawing shows a single-side (handed) unit; the mirrored opposite-side unit is presumed.

functions.name: rear position lamp (presence/visibility signalling)
functions.description: Emits red light to the rear to indicate the vehicle's presence and width.

functions.name: stop lamp (braking indication)
functions.description: Emits higher-intensity red light to the rear when the service brake is applied.

functions.name: reversing lamp (reversing illumination)
functions.description: Emits white light to the rear to illuminate the area behind the vehicle and warn others that the vehicle is reversing or about to reverse.

functions.name: retro-reflection (passive conspicuity)
functions.description: Reflects incident light back towards its source through moulded prism optics, so the vehicle is visible when unlit.

functions.name: light transmission and colour definition (outer lens)
functions.description: The outer lens transmits and filters light to the required colour and protects the internal optics from the environment.

parts.name: Housing
parts.role: Main body carrying the optics, light sources and lens; it is the structure that mounts to the vehicle.

parts.name: Rear position lamp
parts.role: Light function module producing rear position light.

parts.name: Stop lamp
parts.role: Light function module producing braking indication light.

parts.name: Reversing lamp
parts.role: Light function module producing white reversing light.

parts.name: Reflector surface (LED reflector cups / reversing reflector)
parts.role: Collects and directs the LED light output; the drawing shows an array of 24 cup reflectors and a faceted reflector in the reversing compartment.

parts.name: Outer lens
parts.role: Closes the housing, defines the emitted colour and protects the internals.

parts.name: Reversing lamp window/insert in outer lens
parts.role: Separately framed, vertically fluted optical area of the lens positioned over the reversing compartment.

parts.name: Seal / gasket
parts.role: Seals the lens to the housing against water and dust ingress.

parts.name: Fasteners / clips
parts.role: Retain the lamp to the vehicle body and/or hold the internal assemblies.

electronics: LED light sources mounted on PCB(s) for the rear position, stop and reversing functions
Drawing: a 3 x 8 array of LED reflector cups (24 positions)
Drawing: a row of 8 small circular elements above the cup array, possibly additional LEDs
Drawing: a round light-source element at the top of the reversing compartment
Internal wiring and electrical connector to the vehicle harness (implied; not shown)
vehicle_interfaces: Mechanical attachment to the rear body panel/aperture via fasteners or clips
Electrical connection to the vehicle wiring harness to receive switched signals: position/tail lamp, brake signal and reverse gear signal
Outer lens surface flush with the rear body styling; seal against the body or housing
drawing_observations: Upper view shows the housing interior with the lens removed; lower view shows the outer lens.
Left section contains three horizontal rows of 8 metallised reflector cups (24 total), arranged in stepped tiers.
A row of 8 small circular features in individual partitioned cells sits above the cup rows; these may be LEDs, light-guide inputs or screw bosses.
A blank rectangular compartment in the centre of the housing may house the retro-reflector or another optical element.
An elongated, tapered recessed channel along the upper edge of the housing has no evident light source in it.
Right-lower section has a separate square compartment with a curved faceted (multi-segment) reflector and a semicircular light-source element at the top, consistent with the reversing lamp.
The outer lens has a distinct, separately bordered rectangular insert with vertical flutes at its lower right, aligned with the reversing compartment.
The diagonal hatch lines on the lens indicate a smooth transparent surface.
The drawing shows no PCB, connector, seal, fasteners or mounting points.
uncertainties: The spec labels the material table as representative values to be confirmed against the actual bill of materials.
The outer lens is specified as red-tinted, yet the reversing lamp must emit white light; the colour of the fluted reversing window (assumed clear) is not stated.
The location of the retro-reflector in the assembly is not identifiable from the drawing (it could be the central rectangular compartment or a lens-integrated area).
The assignment of the cup rows and small circular elements to the position and stop functions is not specified; the two functions may share the same LEDs at different intensities.
The function of the elongated upper channel is unclear; it may be a light guide or a purely styling feature.
The number of LEDs, the PCB layout, the connector type and the operating voltage are not specified.
The mounting method, the fastening points and the vehicle side (left or right) are not specified.
